sections.heading: Using TZed
sections.body: TZed is a marketplace where people in Tanzania and Zambia buy and sell physical goods. You must be at least 18 and give accurate information. One person, one account.

sections.heading: Listings
sections.body: Every listing is reviewed by TZed before it appears. Only list items you own and are allowed to sell. Prohibited items (see the Help centre) are removed, and accounts that break the rules may be suspended.

sections.heading: Orders, payment and delivery
sections.body: Buyers and sellers agree payment and delivery between themselves. TZed records orders but does not take payments, hold money or handle customs. Converted prices are approximate; the agreed price is in the seller's currency.

sections.heading: Reports and moderation
sections.body: Anyone can report a listing, user or message. TZed admins review reports and may remove content or suspend accounts. Admin actions are recorded in an audit log.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, email, country, and optionally your phone number and shop details. Listings, orders, messages and reviews you create. Basic security logs (sign-ins, IP address) to protect accounts.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: To run the marketplace: show your listings, connect buyers and sellers, send account emails, and keep the platform safe. We don't sell your data.

sections.heading: Who sees it
sections.body: Buyers see your shop name, town and listings. Your phone number is only shared with a buyer after you accept their order. TZed admins can see account data to moderate the platform.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can download all your data or delete your account at any time from My account. After deletion, past orders and messages remain for the other party's records, shown as "Deleted user". These rights follow Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Act 2022 and Zambia's Data Protection Act 2021.
